from libqtile.layout.ratiotile import GridInfo, RatioTile

# direct computation for the exact call path parameters
ratio=0.63
num_windows=11
total_width=997
total_height=743
xoffset=17
yoffset=29

gi = GridInfo(ratio, num_windows, total_width, total_height)
rows, cols, orientation = gi.calc(num_windows, total_width, total_height)
print('calc', rows, cols, orientation)

width = 0
height = 0
results = []
state = None
if orientation == 1:
    y = 0
    for i, row in enumerate(range(rows)):
        x = 0
        width = total_width // cols
        for j, col in enumerate(range(cols)):
            height = total_height // rows
            if i == rows - 1 and j == 0:
                remaining = num_windows - len(results)
                width = total_width // remaining
            elif j == cols - 1 or len(results) + 1 == num_windows:
                width = total_width - x
            results.append((x + xoffset, y + yoffset, width, height))
            if len(results) == num_windows:
                state = dict(orientation=orientation, i=i, j=j, x=x, y=y, width=width, height=height)
                break
            x += width
        if state is not None:
            break
        y += height
else:
    x = 0
    for i, col in enumerate(range(cols)):
        y = 0
        height = total_height // rows
        for j, row in enumerate(range(rows)):
            width = total_width // cols
            if i == cols - 1 and j == 0:
                remaining = num_windows - len(results)
                height = total_height // remaining
            elif j == rows - 1 or len(results) + 1 == num_windows:
                height = total_height - y
            results.append((x + xoffset, y + yoffset, width, height))
            if len(results) == num_windows:
                state = dict(orientation=orientation, i=i, j=j, x=x, y=y, width=width, height=height)
                break
            y += height
        if state is not None:
            break
        x += width

print('state', state)
print('last', results[-1])
print('len', len(results))
PY
